name: Momofuku Bossam (Korean Slow-Roasted Pork Lettuce Wraps)
ingredients_verbatim: 3.5-4 kg / 7-8 lb pork butt (aka Boston butt, upper pork shoulder), bone-in and skinless
1/2 cup (110g) white sugar
1/2 cup (115g) kosher salt
Brown sugar crust: 1 tbsp kosher salt
Brown sugar crust: 7 tbsp brown sugar
Ginger Shallot Sauce: 2.5 cups scallions, thinly sliced
Ginger Shallot Sauce: 1/2 cup fresh ginger, finely grated
Ginger Shallot Sauce: 1/3 cup canola oil
Ginger Shallot Sauce: 1.5 tsp light soy sauce
Ginger Shallot Sauce: 1 tsp sherry vinegar
Ginger Shallot Sauce: 1/2 tsp kosher salt
Spicy Ssam Sauce: 2 tbsp ssamjang
Spicy Ssam Sauce: 1 tbsp gochujang
Spicy Ssam Sauce: 5 tsp sherry vinegar
Spicy Ssam Sauce: 2 tbsp canola oil
Spicy Ssam Sauce: 1 tbsp water
Spicy Ssam Sauce: 1 tsp white sugar
To serve: 40-50+ butter/bib lettuce leaves
To serve: 3 cups cooked white rice
To serve: 500g kimchi
To serve: 12+ raw oysters (optional)
why: Verified in-band on source's own numbers: 626 cal / 67g protein / 18g carbs per serving (serves 10-12). Distinct dry-cured salt-sugar roasted pork butt served as low-carb lettuce wraps -- structurally different from the catalog's gochujang/soy Korean pork RICE bowls (no dupe). Very high protein, low carb. Scales to 14 as one big roast, weigh-and-divide. CONFIDENCE CAVEAT: 626 is near the 650 ceiling; our rebuild would drop the optional oysters (seafood, standing rule) and can trim the small rice garnish and sauce oil, which should pull computed cal toward mid-band, but the selector should treat ceiling proximity as a real risk. Unmapped ingredients (ssamjang, kimchi, sherry vinegar) intentionally left in per the pricer-lane exercise.
